exposure: emotional support during labour and delivery
decisional inclusion during labour and delivery
cohort: Two hundred and twenty-seven primiparous women who delivered their first baby by unplanned caesarean.
finding: Emotional support, being included in decision-making, and present perception of preparedness predicted birth satisfaction, while personality and desire for control did not.
cross-section timing: Postpartum (timing not specified, but retrospectively viewing the birth experience)
